newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar ends firmer in active trading.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar ends firmer in active trading.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar closed much firmer on Friday at C$1.3485
(US$0.7416) from Thursday's close at C$1.3521 (US$0.7396) in
* Buying of Canadian dollars against the German mark in mid-morning gave the currency its main boost, dealers said. * U.S. investment firms were also buying.
Employment statistics released Friday morning also helped the Canadian currency, dealers said.

Statistics Canada reported that the country's unemployment rate fell to 9.7 percent in December from 10 percent in November. Economists in a Reuters survey had forecast, on average, a fall to 9.84 percent.

The numbers encouraged the currency market since market players felt the Bank of Canada would not ease interest rates any time soon. A decrease in Canadian interest rates during a time when U.S. rates are heading up would weaken confidence in the Canadian dollar, traders say.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar rose to 1.1758 marks from Thursday's closing level of 1.1659 marks and climbed to 86.05 yen from 86.00 yen.
